item.title: Why AI Slop Is Hard to Read: Zonder Labs Measures Unclear Writing
item.description: Zonder Labs breaks AI slop down into three clarity faults and measures them across articles and coding discussions: 78% of Claude Code reply sentences are unclear, compared with 11% on Stack Overflow.

item.title: You Own What You Ship: Reading the No AI Slop Manifesto
item.description: A plain-language walkthrough of the No AI Slop manifesto written by AIE Code Summit 2026 speakers and attendees: its definition of slop, the asymmetry behind it, five values, and twelve resolutions, with practical examples and a check against this blog’s own curation pipeline.

item.title: Analyzing Anti-Slop Agent Skills and the Rules Behind #1 stop-slop
item.description: Four top anti-slop prompt skills capture 97% of installs, led by stop-slop’s concrete rules against adverbs, three-item lists, and AI contrast tropes.
